paragraphs.text: A basketball desktop pet for the DSH Web UI — drag the hoop anywhere, flick the ball in, bouncy phys
ics and a daily score.
# Hoops Pet · 篮球桌宠
A desktop pet for the **DSH Web UI**: a real basketball that lives on top of your workspace, a hoop
and a ball crate you can drag anywhere, and a score that resets every day.
> 中文说明见 README.zh.md
## Why you'll like it
- **It feels physical.** Gravity, air drag, spin, rolling friction, wall bounce and a squash-and-str

etch on every impact — not a CSS animation loop.
- **It never gets in your way.** The pet lives in a
click-through overlay: the ball, the hoop and the crate accept pointer events, everything else you

click goes straight through to the app.
- **It's a tiny game.** Drag the hoop where you want it, fli
ck the ball in, and watch the net drop when it swishes. The score is kept per day.
## Features
| 🏀 **Bouncy ball** | Gravity `2400 px/s²`, floor restitution `0.78`, air drag, spin. Hits compress

it, fast falls stretch it. |
| 🥅 **Draggable hoop** | Glass backboard, steel bracket, gradient rim a

nd a diamond net that swings on a swish. Drag it by the rim, the board or the bracket. |
| 📦 **Dragg
able crate** | Ball rests inside until you take it out. Drag the crate with the ball in it — the bal

l comes along. |
| 🖱️ **Flick to throw** | 110 ms of pointer samples become the release velocity (ca

pped at 2600 px/s). Throw flat, lob it, or bank it off the board. |
| 🎯 **Scoring** | Dropping throu
gh the rim gives +1, a net swish, a `+1` pop and a bump on the score plate. Rim and board give real

bounces. |
| 📅 **Daily score** | The count is stored per calendar day and flips back to 0 after midn

ight, even while the page stays open. |
| 💾 **Stays where you put it** | Hoop and crate positions ar

e remembered across reloads. |
| ♿ **Reduced motion** | With `prefers-reduced-motion` the pet stops

nudging itself but still reacts to your input. |
| 🔒 **No network, no storage of anything else** | P
ure rendering. The only persisted data is your score and the two positions. |

Then reload the page (`Ctrl+R`). The pet mounts into the `shell.overlay` slot of the Web UI.
## How to play
| Action | Result |

| Click the crate | The ball pops out |
| Drag the ball and release | It flies off with your throw |

| Click the ball (no drag) | It hops in place |
| Drag the hoop's rim / board / bracket | The hoop

moves, the score plate follows |
| Drag the crate | The crate moves; a ball inside comes with it |
|

Drop the ball onto the crate | The ball is put away |
| Throw the ball through the rim | **+1** |
## How it works
Single-file client plugin (`client.js`), no build step, no runtime dependencies. It registers one co
mponent on the `shell.overlay` slot and runs its own `requestAnimationFrame` loop that writes `trans
form` directly — React never re-renders per frame.
- Physics constants: `GRAVITY 2400`, `FLOOR_REST 0.78`, `WALL_REST 0.84`, rim `1.72`, board `0.62`,

air drag `0.1`
- Collisions: floor, both walls, ceiling, both rim tips (as small circles) and the ba

ckboard edge
- Scoring: the ball must cross the rim plane downward, moving down, inside the inner ga

p
- Storage: `dsh-basketball-pet:score:v1`, `dsh-basketball-pet:layout:v1` (localStorage)
## Compatibility

- DSH Web UI with the `shell.overlay` slot and the `@deepseek-ai/dsh-client-ui-slots` service
- Any
Chromium/Electron/WebKit-based DSH desktop build; no Node, no native code
